# Remaining vendors via npm

- `libphonenumber-js/core` → `libphonenumber-js/core.js`
- `libphonenumber-js/min/metadata` → `libphonenumber-js/min/metadata.js`
- `fuse.js` → `fuse.js`
- `numeral` → `numeral.js`
- `crypto-js` → `crypto-js.js`
- `nanoid` → `nanoid.js`
- `tslib` → `tslib.js`
- `pify` → `pify.js`
- `dataurl-to-blob` → `dataurl-to-blob.js`
- `lodash/debounce` → `lodash/debounce.js`
- `lodash/throttle` → `lodash/throttle.js`
- `react-is` → `react-is.js`
- `ahooks` → `ahooks.js`
- `@plasmohq/messaging` → `@plasmohq/messaging.js`
- `@plasmohq/storage` → `@plasmohq/storage.js`
- `@plasmohq/storage/hook` → `@plasmohq/storage/hook.js`
- `intl-tel-input/data` → `intl-tel-input/data.js`
- `intl-tel-input/i18n/en` → `intl-tel-input/i18n/en.js`
- `intl-tel-input/react` → `intl-tel-input/react.js`
- `react-draggable` → `react-draggable.js`
- `react-lottie` → `react-lottie.js`

Regenerate: `npm run replace:remaining`
